definitions: The property possessed by an object of producing different sensations on the eye as a result of the way it reflects or emits light.
The use of all colours, not just black and white.
The distinctive flag or emblem of a regiment, club, or ship.
The natural shade of a person's skin.
examples: The colour of the sky was a vibrant blue.
She added a touch of colour to the painting.
The film was shot in colour.
The regiment marched with their colours flying.
He had a healthy colour to his cheeks.
